UI_HealthBar.channels: atlas rows (V bottom-up): armour 0-0.25, fill 0.25-0.5, plate 0.5-1. Plate: R top rim, G shade, A cover (draw at PlateColor, alpha 0.5*A). Fill: R sheen, G body, B 10 % ticks, A cover. Armour: eight segments, R sheen, G body, A cover. Colour = tint * G + R * 0.35 (B darkens by 0.25)

HealthBar_Plate.note: plate behind the lines (0.004 further from the camera); UV2.x 0..1 along the bar: the shader clips UV2.x > _Fill (cut from the right) so the mesh is never scaled

HealthBar_Fill.note: health line; pivot = bar anchor; UV2.x 0..1 along the bar: the shader clips UV2.x > _Fill (cut from the right) so the mesh is never scaled

HealthBar_Armour.note: armour line above the health line; UV2.x 0..1 along the bar: the shader clips UV2.x > _Fill (cut from the right) so the mesh is never scaled
